title: 1,289 datasets retired by an xx/xxx name prefix; the convention is undocumented
observation: Retired by name prefix and/or category words (`obsolete`: 803, `notMaintained`: 441, current category: 45; 57 `obsolete` datasets carry no prefix). The convention is undocumented; consumers that match by name anchor on retired datasets unknowingly.
method: Patch 0003 adds a maintenance extension attribute to the 1,289 datasets; names and categories unchanged. The 57 obsolete datasets without a prefix are not flagged.

answer.summary: BAFU said that these datasets should be avoided and that they will move to a 'not maintained' category in its next release.

next.action: Verify the 'not maintained' category in the next BAFU release; ask whether the 57 unprefixed obsolete datasets belong to it (sentier-importers' obsolete test already includes the category; patch 0003 does not).

retained.text: A `maintenance` column (obsolete / not_maintained / current) and a `retired_prefix` boolean in sentier-inventory, keeping both raw signals.
